name: Build a talk around one real case
why: The full method behind the talk or pitch script skill: one true case, three points and one ask.

name: Write a short pitch and fix it after every no
why: Pairs with the pitch path of the talk skill when a founder needs a 60-second and a 3-minute pitch, then a fix after feedback.

name: Pitch revision log
why: Turns the reasons investors or buyers gave for saying no into a ranked fix list, as the pitch fix job needs.

name: Elevator pitch writer
why: Gives 10, 30 and 60 second versions of what the speaker does, useful as the opening of a longer talk.

name: Funny speech planner
why: Builds a toast or wedding speech from one true story with the pause marked, alongside the humour safety check prompt.

name: Read-aloud speech shaper
why: Shapes notes into a speech made to be heard, with breath marks, which suits eulogies and tributes.

name: Witty line punch-up
why: Adds two or three sharp, true lines to a toast or speech without turning the rest into a stand-up set.

name: Lesson talk writer
why: Turns a speaker's own stories into a short talk with repeatable lessons, for graduations, awards and leaving speeches.

name: Launch talk writer
why: Writes a timed two-minute launch talk with one story and a demo, a common remarks job.

name: Hostile-room speech planner
why: Plans a speech for a room that disagrees, which the test briefs include.

name: Talk tension planner
why: Reorders a talk so the room knows the stakes in the first minute, a quick fix for flat openings.

name: Figures to plain pictures writer
why: Turns the numbers in a talk into comparisons a listening room can picture, as the writing-for-the-ear rules ask.

name: PowerPoint speaker notes builder
why: Builds speaker notes and a timing plan inside a deck, ready for Presenter View during rehearsal.
